wa_glacier_peak_kennedy_glacier.trailhead_note: Our pin is North Fork Sauk (WTA coordinates 48.0582, -121.2881; Peakbagger log gives 48.05838, -121.28809, 2070 ft). The approach text says the standard historical Kennedy Glacier approach is from White Chuck River TH (FS-23, road closed), with North Fork Sauk as the open alternate. Pin therefore matches the alternate, not the text's primary way in. No Kennedy-Glacier-specific one-way figure found; the 18.3 mi log is Cool/Suiattle Glacier from North Fork Sauk.

Mackinaw camp: water at North Fork Sauk River and a pit toilet; White Pass camp has pit toilet and stream water; toilet at trailhead
Access: Mountain Loop Hwy about 16 mi SE of Darrington, left on Road 49 (North Fork Sauk/Sloan Creek), 6.5 mi to trailhead
Upper mountain technical; glacier climb gear (ice axe, crampons, rope) used per logs; typical trip 2 days+

wa_storm_king_southwest_scramble.trailhead_note: No published trailhead-to-Storm-King-summit one-way figure found from Colonial Creek, Stehekin or Cascade Pass. NPS gives only to Park Creek Pass (19.6 mi), which exceeds our stored 21.7 km (13.5 mi) one-way, suggesting the stored dist_km is not a Colonial Creek trailhead to summit walk. Our pin is Colonial Creek, matching the approach text's most common line. A climber's Goode/Storm King trip started at Bridge Creek TH (PCT) instead, a fourth access.
